name: Cooking Oil
description: TSA rules for cooking oil on planes.

carryOn.reason: Cooking oils (olive oil, vegetable oil, coconut oil) are liquids and subject to the TSA 3-1-1 rule in carry-on bags. Containers must be 3.4 oz (100ml) or less.
conditions: Must fit in quart-sized clear bag

checkedBag.reason: Cooking oil in sealed containers is allowed in checked baggage. Pack securely to prevent leaks.
conditions: Place in zip-lock bags to prevent leaks

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring cooking oil on a plane?

travelTips: Pack larger oil bottles in checked baggage in sealed zip-lock bags to prevent leaks at altitude

faq.question: Can I bring cooking oil on a plane?
faq.answer: In carry-on bags, cooking oil must be 3.4 oz or less (3-1-1 rule). Full-size bottles must go in checked baggage.

faq.question: Can I bring olive oil in my checked suitcase?
faq.answer: Yes, sealed bottles of olive oil and other cooking oils are allowed in checked baggage. Pack them securely to prevent leaks.
